entities.name: José Luis Bustamante y Rivero
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Bustamante y Rivero was a lawyer, writer, politician, and diplomat who served as President of Peru from 1945 to 1948. He was ousted from office in the 1948 Peruvian coup d'état. He also served as the president of the International Court of Justice in The Hague from 1967 to 1970.

entities.summary: José Luis Bustamante y Rivero was a lawyer, writer, politician, and diplomat who served as President of Peru from 1945 to 1948. He was ousted from office in the 1948 Peruvian coup d'état. He also served as the president of the International Court of Justice in The Hague from 1967 to 1970.
